caption: The warp and the dissolve must use the same t, or the moving shape and its colour drift apart. Here control point A(0, 0) travels to B(100, 40); at t = 0.3 it sits at (30, 12) and the colours are weighted 0.7 and 0.3.

spec.title: Image morph pipeline
spec.aria: A flow from source image to matched control points to warping at t = 0.3 to cross-dissolve to the output frame.
